# S.K. Kunatham Group (เอส.เค.คุณธรรม กรุ๊ป)

> Southern Thailand's largest crane rental and heavy equipment provider. Mobile cranes 25–500 ton, Zero Accident record, 30+ years, 15 southern provinces.

## Services

- [Crane Rental 25–500 Ton](https://www.skkunathamgroup.com/services/crane-rental): Mobile crane rental with certified ปจ.2 operators. Fleet includes XCMG, LIEBHERR, ZOOMLION, TADANO, KOBELCO.
- [Load Testing / Proof Load Test](https://www.skkunathamgroup.com/services/load-test): Certified load testing up to 300 tons using calibrated test weights; MOC-compliant certification.
- [Water Bag Load Test](https://www.skkunathamgroup.com/services/water-bag-load-test): Marine and offshore load testing for ship cranes and platform cranes.
- [Boom Lift Rental](https://www.skkunathamgroup.com/services/boom-lift): Aerial work platforms, 10–30 meter articulating and telescopic lifts.
- [Forklift Rental](https://www.skkunathamgroup.com/services/forklift): 1.5–10 ton counterbalance and rough-terrain forklifts.
- [Hiab Truck Services](https://www.skkunathamgroup.com/services/hiab): 3–15 ton truck-mounted cranes.
- [Heavy Haulage / Trailer](https://www.skkunathamgroup.com/services/trailer): Lowbed and semi-trailers for oversized cargo.

## Extended Company Profile

**S.K. Kunatham Group** is the premier heavy equipment rental company in Southern Thailand, specializing in mobile crane rentals from 25 to 500 tons capacity. With 30+ years of operational excellence and a Zero Accident safety record, we serve as the region's most trusted partner for construction, industrial, maritime, and infrastructure projects across all 15 Southern Thailand provinces.

**Legal Name:** บริษัท เอส.เค.คุณธรรม กรุ๊ป จำกัด (S.K. Kunatham Group Co., Ltd.)
**Founded:** Over 30 years of continuous operation
**Headquarters:** 530 หมู่ที่ 3 ถ.ควนหิน-ทุ่งหวัง ตำบลพะวง อำเภอเมือง จังหวัดสงขลา 90100
**Branch:** รน.4010 ตำบลปากน้ำ อำเภอเมืองระนอง ระนอง 85000
**Phone:** +66 74 333 074 (24/7 Hotline)
**Email:** skservices.skl@gmail.com
**LINE:** @skgroup
**Website:** https://www.skkunathamgroup.com

### Flagship Services

**Mobile Crane Rental (เช่ารถเครน)**
Complete fleet from 25 to 500 tons capacity with certified crane operators (ผู้บังคับรถเครน), signal persons (ผู้ให้สัญญาณ), riggers (ผู้ยึดเกาะวัสดุ), and crane supervisors (ผู้ควบคุมเครน). Full team of 4 specialists required for 200+ ton projects.

**Load Testing Services (ทดสอบน้ำหนัก)**
- Proof Load Test: Certified testing up to 300 tons
- Water Bag Load Test: Marine/offshore load testing for ship and platform cranes
- MOC Certification: Ministry of Commerce standard compliance

**Transportation & Logistics**
Hiab truck services (3–15 ton), heavy haulage lowbed trailers, forklift rental (1.5–10 ton), boom lift rental (10–30 meter).

### Target Industries

- Construction: High-rise buildings, bridges, steel structures, MEP installation
- Industrial: Petrochemical, oil refinery, power plant, factory machinery
- Maritime & Offshore: Port crane operations, ship loading, offshore platforms
- Infrastructure: Airports, railways, highways, telecommunications towers, wind turbines

### Service Coverage

**Primary (1–2 hour response):** Songkhla (headquarters), Hat Yai, Ranong (branch)
**Secondary (2–4 hour response):** Pattani, Yala, Satun, Trang, Phatthalung, Nakhon Si Thammarat
**Extended (4–6 hour response):** Krabi, Phang Nga, Phuket, Surat Thani, Chumphon

### Safety & Certifications

- ปจ.2 (Por Jor 2) — Thai Ministry of Transport crane operator certification
- คป.2 (Kor Por 2) — Crane supervisor certification
- Zero Accident record maintained over 10+ years
- Regular equipment inspection and certified operator training
- Safety planning required for every project

### Why Choose S.K. Kunatham Group

1. Only 500-ton crane in Southern Thailand (XCMG XCA500L8, available 2026)
2. 24/7 emergency hotline: +66 74 333 074
3. Complete service package: equipment + operators + rigging + supervision
4. Transparent pricing with free detailed quotations
5. Multilingual support: Thai, English, Chinese

### Pricing Structure

- 25–35 Ton: Competitive daily rates
- 50–80 Ton: Mid-range daily rates with operator included
- 100–150 Ton: Premium rates for large capacity
- 200–300 Ton: Project-based quotations
- 500 Ton: Advance booking required
- Factors: capacity, duration (daily/weekly/monthly), distance, complexity, manpower
